mark start
warp GanonCastle GanonCastleEntrance adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark llegada
wait 3000               # B loads after A (r03_pareja) or with it (run.ps1): wait for it
mark r01-puerta            # the main gate
place 42.30 99.70 228.60
wait 300
flag GanonCastle_IsOpenMainGate 1
wait 600               # the other one sees us in this room
mark salida             # into InsideGanonCastle
goto 40.90 221.30 0.8 900
wait 1800               # the scene change, then the other one lands too
mark fin
